What you will do: - Deliver online groceries to customers - Handle payments at the door (if the customer chooses to pay upon delivery) - Make sure the customer is satisfied with the groceries they receive During your delivery shift, you'll also take time for a friendly chat - and every day, you'll drive a different route to reach customers. That's exactly what makes working as a delivery driver so enjoyable! On average, a shift lasts 6 hours, not including the time it takes to load your vehicle. Shift Times: - Morning shift: 06:00 - 15:00 - Evening shift: 15:00 - 23:00 Over het bedrijf Your new employer, Albert Heijn Online, thinks it is important that you can be yourself in an environment that is open to different perspectives. They challenge you to be good at your job and to develop every day to become even better at it. Finally, there are plenty of career opportunities here.
